{{Quote|Shadow Twelve standing by.|Shadow Twelve|<ref name="som" />}}
"'''Shadow Twelve'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] participated in a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|mission]] to destroy the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. During the mission, he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] his [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] through the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]], evading [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] along the way. Later, when arriving near the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], where the ''Malevolence'' had arrived, the pilot managed to evade an ion blast from the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. In the ensuing battle, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and Shadow [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] managed to cripple the ion weapons of the ''Malevolence'', saving the [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] from destruction.

==Biography==
{{Quote|While our capital ships are vulnerable to the enemy's attack, I believe a squad of bombers can outmaneuver their ion weapon. Our target will be the bridge&hellip;and General Grievous.|Anakin Skywalker, to Shadow Squadron|audio=OurTargetIsTheBridge-SoM.flac|<ref name="som" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Kaliida.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Squadron engages the ''Malevolence''.]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="db" /> "Shadow Twelve" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[unit]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]].<ref name="som" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] constructed<ref name="tvg">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]&mdash;a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> armed with two [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] capable of neutralizing the power of an enemy [[Starship/Legends|ship]]&mdash;for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|defeat]] of a Republic task force in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]],<ref name="rm">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] devised a plan to stop the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. Skywalker would lead Shadow Squadron, including Shadow Twelve, on a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|mission]] to destroy the ''Malevolence,'' which was on its way to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], where 60,000 wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were being treated. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] would then destroy the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], killing the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="som" />

Shadow Squadron, which had been joined by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], departed from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Skywalker contacted all [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and after they had checked in with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General, the squadron jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Emerging at the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], Skywalker led Shadow Squadron to the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]], a shortcut to the medical center. Skywalker was, however, unaware of the [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] inhabiting the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. Evading the massive creatures, Shadow Twelve and the squadron made their way out from the nebula, arriving at the medical center just as the ''Malevolence'' emerged from hyperspace. The massive warship targeted the Republic group, launching an ion ray from one of its ion cannons. Five pilots were caught in the ion ray, but Shadow Twelve and the rest of the squadron continued toward the ''Malevolence''. Due to the increasing [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire, Tano and Koon advised Skywalker to abandon the original attack plan. Skywalker ordered Shadow Twelve and Shadow Squadron to fire their [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the starboard ion cannon, which was targeting the medical center. The squadron successfully managed to cripple the weapons, stopping the ''Malevolence'' from destroying the medical center.<ref name="som" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper with the call sign "Shadow Twelve" first appeared in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]]. Like every clone trooper in the series, "Shadow Twelve" was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
